en: For the conductor; of the servant of Havayah, of Dovid.

he: נְאֻֽם־פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין־פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
en: The utterance of transgression to the wicked is in my heart: there is no fear of G-d before his eyes.

he: כִּֽי־הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃
en: For he made smooth to himself in his eyes, to find his iniquity, to hate.

he: דִּבְרֵי־פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃
en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; he has ceased to be wise, to do good.

he: אָ֤וֶן ׀ יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל־מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃
en: He plans iniquity upon his bed; he stands upon a way that is not good; evil he does not despise.
Havayah, in the heavens is Your kindness; Your faithfulness reaches the skies.

he: צִדְקָתְךָ֨ ׀ כְּֽהַרְרֵי־אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם־וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהֹוָֽה׃
en: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains; Your judgments are a great deep; man and beast You save, Havayah.

he: מַה־יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃
en: How precious is Your kindness, G-d; and the children of man take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.

he: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃
en: They shall be sated from the fatness of Your house, and of the river of Your delights You shall give them drink.
For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we shall see light.
Extend Your kindness to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright of heart.
Let not the foot of pride come upon me, and let not the hand of the wicked make me wander.

he: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃ {פ}
en: There the workers of iniquity have fallen; they were thrust down, and could not rise.
